svg.title: Prepare the ethylenediamine solution
svg.desc: Dissolve appropriate amounts of analytically pure lead acetate and selenium powders in ethylenediamine. The typical characterized sample uses 0.05 kmol/m³ lead acetate in selenium-saturated ethylenediamine. Absolute charges, volume, dissolution duration and addition order are unreported. Source-bound concept; no physical apparatus geometry is established.

g.text: Source-bound concept; no vessel, dimensions or fill levels inferred.
Xie et al. 1999 · Exact source locators and limits in the protocol
